mechanism: Both drugs inhibit the renin-angiotensin-aldosterone system (RAAS) through different mechanisms, leading to additive effects on blood pressure reduction and increased risk of hyperkalemia, renal dysfunction, and hypotension.
action: Monitor serum potassium levels and renal function regularly; use combination cautiously in patients with baseline renal impairment, diabetes, or elevated potassium; adjust doses as needed and consider alternative agents if potassium levels become elevated.
